products.name: LMSYS Arena Models
products.note: Model evaluation platform; crowdsourced benchmarking; research transparency; no production use

profile_text.body:
LMSYS operates the platform found at lmarena.ai, which it describes as an official AI ranking and LLM leaderboard where users can chat with, compare, and vote on AI models. The site presents itself as a community-driven effort to evaluate large language models, image models, and code models through real-world use, with conversations and related personal information disclosed to AI providers and potentially made public to support research. The platform also uses user conversations for automated evaluation, sending prompts to AI providers at a later time to score and compare their models.

The organization's tracked product, listed under the category of Chat and General LLMs, is LMSYS Arena Models, characterized as a model evaluation platform built around crowdsourced benchmarking and research transparency, with no production use. LMSYS is recorded as a nonprofit organization, verified as of August 2026. No litigation, MCP server registrations, SEC filings, or patent records are held for the organization.
